articles.title: Move to rejoin EU among options for UK, says Burnham
articles.description: The prime minister tells the BBC the current Brexit settlement has caused "more harm than good".

articles.title: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
articles.description: The key thing to understand about Andy Burnham's speech is these were the words and the delivery of both a new prime minister and a grieving son, the BBC's political editor writes.

articles.title: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
articles.description: A typical household faces an annual gas and electricity bill of £1,999 from January, based on a key forecast.

articles.title: One of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford called 999 himself
articles.description: He made the call almost an hour before a farmer also called police after seeing men in balaclavas.
